name: Steninge - Haverdal
description: Steninge to Haverdal. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official page/API say 7.3 km, GPX desc says Total: 7 km, and computed geometry length is about 7.029 km.
K4 ends in Frillesås while K5 starts at Steninge, about 67.2 km away.
K5 has complete official GPX/API geo_json LineString but API line.geometry has no usable coordinates.
Haverdal directly intersects the GPX, while Enet is only about 5 m from the GPX, Särdal about 387 m and Steningekusten about 161 m from the route.
Official K5 is green/easy, while local-loop comments mention rocky sections and difficulty running/following a local route.
Official K5 feed has no dricksvatten record, but Haverdals Camping can offer water refill as an off-route facility/day-fee/customer service.
